blocked_actions.reason: Destructive change requires change board approval and is outside incident scope
Security-sensitive change requires security approval and is outside incident scope
Broad infra scaling requires separate approval and is outside incident scope

rationale: Scope boundary: Approved incident scope is limited to checkout diagnostics only; destructive, security-sensitive, and broad capacity changes are explicitly excluded
Risk boundary: Drop orders table is destructive and poses data loss risk; credential rotation is security-sensitive; both require specialized approval gates
Approval boundary: Policy mandates change board review for destructive changes and security approval for credential rotations; incident commander lacks authority for these actions
